title: Node locking is not respected in sub-scenes
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in:
- 4.4.beta1
- 4.3.stable
- 4.2.stable
- 4.2.2.stable
- 4.1.stable
- 4.1.4.stable
- 4.0.stable
- 4.0.4.stable
- 3.6.stable
- 3.0.stable

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable unknown - EndeavourOS #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat, 18 Jan 2025 02:26:57 +0000 - Wayland - GLES3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT (radeonsi, navi14, LLVM 19.1.6, DRM 3.59, 6.12.10-arch1-1) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 Threads)

### Issue description

As the title states, locked nodes are not respected in sub-scenes; except when editable children is enabled.
This is relevant for my use case as follows:
I have lights consisting of 2 parts, a Sprite2D and a PointLight2D. The point light is significantly larger than the sprite, getting in the way of selecting other nodes. I don't want to disable selection for the entire scene, as that would make repositioning them difficult. My solution is to disable selection for the point light only, and make it the child of the selectable sprite. This is when I discovered this issue.

I have checked, this issue is present both for 2d, 3d and control nodes

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create new scene named "select_bug_subscene.tscn"
2. Add Sprite2D as root node
2.1. Name it "Not_Locked"
2.2. Assign texture to sprite
3. Create Sprite2D as child of "Not_Locked"
3.1. Name it "Locked"
3.2. Assign texture to sprite
3.3. Move "Locked" so it doesn't overlap "Not_Locked"
3.4. Lock "Locked"
3.5. (optional) rotate "Locked" 45deg for easy identification. 
4. Create new scene named "select_bug_main.tscn"
5. Add Node2D as root node, name it "Root"
6. Add 2 instances of "select_bug_subscene.tscn" as children of "Root"
6.1. Name them "Subscene1" and "Subscene2"
6.2. Move "Subscene2" so "Subscene2/Locked" so it overlaps "Subscene1/." AKA "Subscene1/Not_Locked"
7. Using the context menu, make "Subscene2"_'s children editable
8. Ensure you are in select mode (Q)
9. Click on "Subscene1/Locked" 
9.1. Result: See "Subscene1" is selected
9.2. See: ERROR
10. Deselect everything
11. Click on "Subscene2/Locked"
11.1. Result: See "Subscene2/Locked" is not selected
11.2. Result: See "Subscene1/." AKA "Subscene1/Not_Locked" is selected
11.3. See: ERROR not present with editable children

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[godot_select_bug_report_4.3.stable.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18548563/godot_select_bug_report_4.3.stable.zip)
